say:1:1130334001:1.text: Alas, I've grown too old to do most anything but roast meat on a spit.
say:1:1130334001:1.source_cn: 唉，我年纪大了，现在只能做烤肉这种活了。
say:1:1130334001:1.male: Alas, I've grown too old to do most anything but roast meat on a spit.
say:1:1130334001:1.female: Alas, I've grown too old to do most anything but roast meat on a spit.

say:2:1130334002:1.text: I was once a skilled warrior, but those days are long gone.
say:2:1130334002:1.source_cn: 以前我可是战斗重的一把好手，可是现在再也没办法去了。
say:2:1130334002:1.male: I was once a skilled warrior, but those days are long gone.
say:2:1130334002:1.female: I was once a skilled warrior, but those days are long gone.
